text:
ana (PM): Quick check-in: define the pilot acceptance gate for Private (VPC/on-prem). Need a short checklist we can hand to Sales.
ryan (eng): Core items: installer `--dryrun-network`, preflight that detects CIDR overlap, rolling operator upgrade with canary label, documented manual rollback.
keiko (field): Pilots want explicit IP-preserve guarantees. If we can't promise, we need a clear customer opt-in flag.
mira (netops): Also require customer to supply maintenance window + lead netops contact and sign the network responsibility form for customer-managed NAT.
tom (infra): Snapshot requirement: operator must be able to take a pre-upgrade snapshot; expose `snapshot-ttl`. If infra can't deliver hooks in time, we mark rollback manual.
qa-bot: Acceptance tests to add: `preflight/cidr_overlap.yaml`, `upgrade/zero_churn.yaml`, `rollback/manual_steps.md`.
ana (PM): Gate criteria (proposed): preflight passes in lab topologies (3/3), dryrun validated in 2 pilots, upgrade preserves IPs >=95% in testbench. If missing, we ship Beta.
keiko (field): Signoff checklist for field:
1) preflight: green
2) dryrun-report reviewed
3) sample upgrade on replica cluster
4) failover tested

ryan (eng): UX note: preflight errors should be one-line with remediation link, e.g. `ERROR: CIDR overlap: customer 10.1.0.0/16 vs cluster 10.0.0.0/12  remediation: https://redwood/docs/private/preflight#cidr`.
mira (netops): Add KMS verification step if customer provides CMK.
tom (infra): I'll provide timeline for snapshot hooks Wed.
ana (PM): Action owners: ryan dryrun PR (Thu), mira KMS checklist (Tue), keiko pilot coordination (Fri), qa-bot tests (end of week). We'll reconvene after PRs. :thumbsup:
